segments.title: Cold Open: Fake Commercial Block
segments.notes: Broadcast opens with a surreal montage of parody 1-800 commercials featuring grovelin slaves, dying castlem, and Casim G giving out personal numbers.

segments.title: Call Cas: Listener Call-In Special
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and guest Kendelle (billed as Fiona) host a live call-in show covering Kendelle's European trip, breakup, potential NYC move, neurodivergency, vaccine stories, WWE storylines, Chappell Roan politics, Katy Perry speculation, Magic: The Gathering bans, Diddy blackmail theories, MCN history, and the lost 'Ass Cast' series.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid
segments.notes: Case thanks subscribers, promotes Wednesday Patreon Vince McMahon watchalong and Cringe Court Episode 2, then raids Gnome Pro after a viewer vote on his remaining streaming hours.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Hosts call-in show 'Call Cas' with guest Kendelle, fields calls on vaccines, WWE, Magic bans, and Diddy allegations.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appears as Fiona discussing Europe trip, breakup, potential move to New York, and neurodivergency.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: recurring. Briefly warms up the broadcast with a racial comedy bit before exiting.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Manages call screening via Danksauce during the call-in segment.

lore_notes.fact: Kendelle considering moving back to New York due to brother leaving LA and industry implosion.
Case received Johnson & Johnson COVID vaccine and drove two hours to San Antonio via a Slack channel to get it.
Case states he made zero money from his MCN arrangement.
Case appears as a stenographer in 'Cringe Court Episode 2' on YouTube.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News airs a special call-in edition of 'Call Cas' with anchor Case Blackwell and guest Kendelle fielding listener calls on topics ranging from Magic: The Gathering card bans and WWE storyline complaints to Diddy blackmail theories and the lost 'Ass Cast' series. Kendelle reveals she is considering leaving Los Angeles for New York amid a personal breakup and industry collapse. The broadcast concludes with a raid on Gnome Pro after a chat vote on Case's remaining streaming lifespan.
